description: WP-12C pinned inventory of LLM/provider egress sites. Keyed by unique call-site identity '<relpath>::<qualified-scope>::<kind>#<ordinal>'. The alias-resolving, terminal-complete scanner (assurance/egress_scan.py) must find exactly this set: no new uninventoried site, no stale entry. 'location' is advisory (line:col at pinning time); the identity key is line-independent so refactors don't churn the pin. POST-PRIV-001b (PR #328): every runtime request-path provider call has been routed INTO the three services/llm_gateway.py guard_* adapters (the ONLY sanctioned egress points; they scan/redact/reject outbound text before the provider call), and the three operational scripts now route through them too — so there are ZERO raw provider calls outside the adapter. The remaining benchmark entry is an offline LLM-judge on fixture prompts (not production/user data). tests/test_priv001b_egress_guard.py::test_all_provider_egress_is_inside_the_approved_adapter enforces this. Editing this file changes a security bar; it is a protected surface.

services/llm_gateway.py::guard_openai_ch.reason: APPROVED-ADAPTER (PRIV-001b): the one OpenAI-chat egress point; scans/redacts messages before the provider call

services/llm_gateway.py::guard_anthropic.reason: APPROVED-ADAPTER (PRIV-001b): the one Anthropic-messages egress point; scans/redacts system+messages before the provider call

services/llm_gateway.py::guard_openai_em.reason: APPROVED-ADAPTER (PRIV-001b): the one embeddings egress point; scans/redacts input before the provider call

benchmark/pharma_eval.py::llm_judge._jud.reason: offline LLM-judge on fixture prompts, not production/user data
